objective: Test whether independent stable-null calibration of BOTH the causal switch and the nuisance jump, rather than only causal switches, prevents unnecessary nuisance model selection on stable worlds while retaining accurate post-switch causal effects and true exogenous-jump response.

method.original_P48: use original P48 fitted_hypotheses and unchanged BIC and exact factual models
method.candidate: first choose causal switch only if best causal BIC beats best null by its 99th-percentile stable-only margin; otherwise choose nuisance model only if its BIC beats full no-change by an independently calibrated 99th-percentile stable-only nuisance margin; else preserve original full no-change effect
method.independent_threshold_source: only stable-world physical histories, no evaluation labels or trials
method.source_law: reuse exact original P48 authored synthetic physical source distribution with new only seeds; alternative action outcomes not observed, nuisance jumps absolute in [0.40,0.70] ; three frozen frequencies

controls.original_p48: causal-only null calibration using the SAME newly registered stable calibration and evaluation sources
controls.conventional_full: unchanged P47 8-action no-change quadratic nuisance+effect LS
controls.conventional_factual_3_5: unchanged P47 last-3 and last-5 executed-action contrasts
controls.nuisance_only_calibrated: new explicit conventional candidate itself; do not claim novel architectural learning

endpoints.frozen_primary: Each of all 3 cohorts: causal recall >=70%, stable false causal alarms <=10%, nuisance false causal alarms <=10%, post-causal-switch action-effect MAE <=85% of min(trailing5,recency,last5), stable effect MAE <=110% of original full no-change conventional LS; cold replay exact
endpoints.add_exogenous_effect_gate: In each cohort nuisance-only effect MAE <=110% of original P48 same-source nuisance-only effect MAE, since calibration must not harm true nuisance response
endpoints.progress_vs_original_p48: Also report original P48 stable-effect MAE and candidate, and nuisance step selection counts, no postresult changes
endpoints.independent_science_pass: IMPOSSIBLE on authored DEV source alone; original owner-source first-use, fully converged neural controls, mixed nonalternating/endogenous actions and full dual-OS qualification needed
